description: Get Google Trends search interest (0-100) over time for one keyword, optionally with interest by region (US states, regions of a country, or countries when worldwide). Use it to see if a topic is rising, find its peak, or compare seasons. Call once per keyword: each series is scaled 0-100 on its own peak.

geo.description: Country code like US, GB, FR, DE. Empty for worldwide

include_regions.description: Also return interest by region (or by country when worldwide)

keyword.description: One search term, e.g. "chatgpt" or "electric cars"

timeframe.description: Period. Short periods give hourly points, long ones daily or weekly

name: get_interest_over_time
title: Google Trends: interest over time
